$description: Mistral theme: flame orange, slightly tighter radius. Activate with data-theme="mistral" on the root element.

light.$description: The categorical chart scale (--chart-cat-*) is deliberately not themed. A brand palette is for chrome; series identity needs hues that separate, and this theme's own colours are a single family, as a data scale they would encode order instead of identity. See theme.css.

primary-foreground.$description: Black on flame orange (5.5:1), matching Mistral's own brand usage; the previous near-white foreground sat at 3.4:1 and failed AA.

dark.$description: Chart series (dark): lighter orange steps so every series clears the 3:1 graphical minimum on the dark background. Without these the light-block values win on specificity and leak into dark mode.
